interpretation: A pass means retained signing-readiness evidence records sanitized Team ID, provisioning profile, unique bundle ID, non-ad-hoc codesign identity, registered physical-device UDID hashes, and signed-app entitlements for an iPhoneOS artifact. It is not an install, launch, VideoToolbox, input, reconnect, audio, or full iOS device-acceptance pass.
missing: xcode.version: must be a non-empty recorded value
xcode.selected_developer_dir: must be a non-empty recorded value
xcode.ios_sdk: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.bundle_id: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.signed_artifact_sha256: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.team_id_sha256: must be a SHA-256 digest with team_id_recorded=true
signing.provisioning_profile_uuid_sha256: must be a SHA-256 digest with provisioning_profile_recorded=true
signing.codesign_identity_sha256: must be a SHA-256 digest with codesign_identity_recorded=true
signing.signed_artifact_sha256: must be a SHA-256 digest
signing.device_udid_hashes: must include at least one registered physical-device UDID hash
artifacts: must include retained signing command/profile/entitlements output

owner.scope: Phase 5 iOS app-signing readiness prerequisite only

labels.codesign_identity: non-ad-hoc Apple codesign identity recorded as a SHA-256 digest or local-only raw value
labels.device_udids: registered physical iPhone/iPad UDID hashes retained from the provisioning profile
labels.entitlements: signed-app entitlements match Team ID and bundle ID with a retained entitlement plist SHA-256
labels.provisioning_profile: provisioning profile UUID recorded as a SHA-256 digest or local-only raw value
labels.team_id: Apple Team ID recorded as a SHA-256 digest or local-only raw value
